description: This file is a Perl script for generating target configuration and profile makefiles based on target metadata. It includes functions for processing target features, names, versions, and generating configuration blocks for build systems.

methods.name: target_config_features
methods.description: Generates configuration feature strings based on input feature list.

methods.name: target_name
methods.description: Returns the name of a target, including parent name if available.

methods.name: kver
methods.description: Converts version strings to a standardized format for comparison.

methods.name: print_target
methods.description: Prints configuration blocks for a target, including dependencies and features.

methods.name: merge_package_lists
methods.description: Merges two package lists, removing duplicates and handling negations.

methods.name: gen_target_config
methods.description: Generates a full target configuration based on parsed target metadata.

methods.name: gen_profile_mk
methods.description: Generates profile-specific makefile entries from target metadata.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and invokes appropriate generation functions.
